plan.authorization: User selected option 1: confirm shortlisted configurations
plan.claim: Configured-model comparison, not isolated capacity or federation effects
plan.checkpoint_selection: First strict maximum validation macro-F1 within 60 steps; no cross-seed winner selection
plan.reporting: Every seed and every class; mean and sample SD for seeds 0/1/2 and separately new seeds 1/2. SD is not a confidence interval.
plan.test_policy: No test evaluation. Previously inspected historical test cannot become fresh confirmation.
limitations: Seed 0 influenced screening and is not independent confirmation.
All seeds reuse the same validation set; these are training-seed stability checks, not independent data confirmation.
Fixed partition seed measures no variability across client partitions.
Normalization differs between central-light and federated-light; dropout differs between heavy and light.
No deployment or physical edge claim; no cloud resources.
plan.execution_policy: Run only the eight authorized new-seed jobs; do not tune after observing them. Preserve seed-zero artifacts in place.
